fields.text: Upload a flat graphic / packaging still; Ideogram V3 Remove Text (`ideogram-v3-remove-text`) strips lettering while preserving the surrounding design. Size auto, $0.09/image. First-click story is a flat Volt pocket night-ride radio packaging / promo card (matte charcoal field, one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron) with unwanted promotional lettering — this repo has no committed still, so upload that card or any lettered graphic. NOT Clean product photo (Muse Edit relight), NOT Product cutout (BiRefNet bg knock-out), NOT Text-selected isolate (SAM 3), NOT P-Image Upscale, and NOT Transparent brand sticker (text→transparent). The edit prompt is a runner instruction (catalog is image-only). Inspect the native cleanup; Export preview is a local 1024 fit only.

fields.prompt: Remove all lettering, captions, watermarks and promotional text from this flat graphic. Preserve the exact product/artwork, materials, colors, marks and composition. Fill removed text regions so the design looks continuous. Do not restyle, recolor, invent props, or change layout.
